name: Inaho Shin
source: A frequenter of the Cubic Café and a freeter. He recently returned from a trip around India, and now works part-time at the chain restaurant "Ressac." His favourite greeting is "[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Namaste]Namaste[/url]." He owns a bicycle that he uses to get around and race [url=/c7874]Shougo[/url] with. He runs a travel blog, documenting his journey in India and eventually other places. He respects [url=/c11645]Tenchou[/url].
